hero.title: Fees & commissions explained simply
hero.subtitle: On farme.ro, you pay producer prices and see clearly what delivery costs and platform commission mean. No hidden surprises.

pill1.title: Producer price
pill1.description: Products are listed by real producers, and prices are set by them.

pill2.description: A small portion of the order value goes to farme.ro for platform operation and development.

pill3.title: No hidden costs
pill3.description: See the final cost before confirming your order, including delivery.

producerPrice.title: What does "producer price" mean?
producerPrice.description: farme.ro is a marketplace. This means we don't set product prices, producers do. They set the right price for their work, and you see those prices directly on the platform. farme.ro only retains a transparent commission to operate and promote their products.

forClient.title: For you, as a client
forClient.description: You pay a fair price, directly from the source, without unclear markups along the way.

forProducer.title: For producer
forProducer.description: Receives more from the final basket value and can better plan production and deliveries.

products.label: 1. Product value
products.description: The sum of products you choose. This money goes, for the most part, directly to the producer.

shipping.label: 2. Delivery cost
shipping.description: Set based on distance, weight and delivery method (home delivery or pickup point, where available).

commission.label: 3. farme.ro commission
commission.description: A small percentage of the order value, used for platform operation, support, development, producer promotion and social impact projects.

points.0: You always see the final cost before confirming your order.
points.1: We don't add hidden fees at the last step.
points.2: Over time, we will display even more clearly how much goes to the producer and how much to the platform.

payment.title: Card payment vs cash on delivery

card.title: Card payment (recommended)
card.description: It's the safest and most efficient option for both you and producers. The order is confirmed, and the risk of uncollected products is lower.

points.2: May come with additional benefits (rewards, offers) in the future.

cash.title: Cash on delivery (where available)
cash.description: In certain situations, you can pay directly upon delivery. To protect producers from uncollected orders, there may be additional logistics fees for this type of payment.

points.0: There may be additional handling/transport fees for cash on delivery.
points.1: The option may be limited for users with many uncollected orders.
points.2: Exact details will be clearly displayed on the checkout page.

earnings.title: How producers earn. How farme.ro earns.

producers.title: Producers
producers.description: Producers receive the amount of products sold, minus a clear platform commission. In return, they get access to new customers, online visibility, order management tools and, in the future, promotion options.

platform.title: farme.ro
platform.description: The platform earns from a small commission per transaction and, potentially, from subscriptions for producers or extra services. The goal is to remain a fair and balanced place for everyone: clients, producers and community.

q1.question: Do I pay anything else besides what I see at checkout?
q1.answer: No. Everything you see on the checkout page is everything you pay. We don't add hidden fees or additional taxes after you confirm your order.

q2.question: Why does delivery cost so much?
q2.answer: Delivery cost depends on distance, weight and delivery method. Each producer manages their own deliveries, and costs are set by them or their logistics partners. You will see the exact cost before confirming your order.

q3.question: Can I see how much the producer receives from my order?
q3.answer: Currently, you see the total product value and delivery cost. As we develop the platform, we will display even more clearly the exact distribution: how much goes to the producer, how much to delivery and how much to the platform.

q4.question: Does the commission change for certain orders?
q4.answer: The platform commission is consistent and transparent. It doesn't vary by product type or order value. If there are differences (for example, for cash on delivery), these will be clearly displayed before you confirm your order.

q5.question: Are there hidden costs or additional fees?
q5.answer: No. Everything you pay is clearly displayed on the checkout page: product value, delivery cost and platform commission. There are no hidden costs or additional fees that appear after you confirm your order.

q1.question: What is farme.ro?
q1.answer: farme.ro is an online marketplace that connects local producers of traditional agricultural products with customers looking for authentic and quality products. We offer a direct platform, without intermediaries, to support the local economy and promote Romanian traditions.

q2.question: How does farme.ro work?
q2.answer: Registered producers can add their products to the platform. Customers can search, filter and order products directly from producers. Each order is processed and delivered directly from producer to customer, ensuring freshness and quality of products.

q3.question: Are products verified?
q3.answer: Yes, all producers are verified before they can list their products. We verify documents, product quality and compliance with food safety standards.

q4.question: How can I find the products I'm looking for?
q4.answer: You can search for products using the search bar, filtering by category, region or price. You can also explore producers and their products directly from dedicated pages.

q1.question: How can I place an order?
q1.answer: You can place an order by selecting the desired products, adding them to cart and completing the order through the checkout process. You will receive order confirmation by email and will be contacted by the producer for delivery details.

q2.question: How is delivery done?
q2.answer: Delivery is managed directly by the producer. Each producer has their own delivery options and costs. Delivery details will be communicated after placing the order.

q3.question: Can I cancel an order?
q3.answer: Order cancellation depends on its status. If the order has not yet been processed by the producer, you can contact the producer directly or our support team for cancellation.

q4.question: How long does delivery take?
q4.answer: Delivery time varies depending on the producer and your location. Usually, orders are delivered within 2-7 business days. The producer will inform you about the exact delivery time after placing the order.

q5.question: Can I track my order?
q5.answer: Yes, you will receive email notifications about your order status. You can also check the order status from your account on the platform.

q1.question: What payment methods do you accept?
q1.answer: We accept payments by bank card, bank transfer and other secure payment methods. All payments are processed through secure and certified third-party services.

q2.question: When is payment processed?
q2.answer: Payment is processed after order confirmation by the producer. For products with pre-order delivery, payment may be processed partially or in full depending on the producer's policy.

q3.question: Is it safe to pay online?
q3.answer: Yes, all payments are processed through secure and certified third-party services. We do not store credit card information or payment methods.

q4.question: Can I get a tax invoice?
q4.answer: Yes, you can request a tax invoice when placing the order. The invoice will be issued by the producer and sent together with the products or by email.

q5.question: What happens if payment is not accepted?
q5.answer: If payment is not accepted, you will receive a notification and can try again with another payment method. The order will not be processed until payment is confirmed.

q1.question: How can I register as a producer?
q1.answer: You can create a producer account by accessing the "For producers" page and completing the registration form. You will be contacted by our team for verification and approval.

q2.question: What are the commissions?
q2.answer: Commissions vary depending on product type and sales volume. Complete details about commissions and payments are available in the producer portal after registration.

q3.question: How do I manage orders?
q3.answer: After registration, you will have access to a dedicated portal where you can manage products, orders, inventory and payments. You will receive notifications for each new order.

q4.question: How do I receive payment for sold products?
q4.answer: Payment is transferred to your bank account after order completion and delivery. Payment frequency can be configured in the producer portal.

q5.question: What documents are needed for registration?
q5.answer: To register as a producer, you will need identification documents, documents certifying your agricultural activity and, if applicable, health authorizations for your products.

story.title: Our story
story.paragraph1: farme.ro emerged from the observation that there is a real need to connect local producers in Romania with customers looking for authentic, traditional and quality products. Many farmers and small producers do not have access to the market or the resources needed to promote their products.
story.paragraph2: At the same time, customers in large cities have difficulty finding authentic traditional products, without intermediaries that increase prices or compromise quality.
story.paragraph3: Our platform solves this problem by offering a direct, transparent and easy-to-use marketplace, where producers can sell directly to customers, and customers can discover and buy traditional Romanian products with confidence.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about the investment opportunity in farme.ro
faq.contactNote: Have other questions? We're here to answer.

q1.question: What types of investments are you looking for?
q1.answer: We're looking for strategic investors for seed round (€500K - €1M) to help us with expansion in the Romanian market and technology development. We're also open to strategic partnerships with investors who can bring value in the agricultural or retail sector.

q2.question: What is the exit model?
q2.answer: Our vision includes either a strategic exit through acquisition by a major player in retail or tech, or an IPO within 5-7 years. The scalable business model and anticipated profitability make farme.ro an attractive candidate for both scenarios.

q3.question: How will you use the funds?
q3.answer: Approximately 60% of funds will be allocated to marketing and producer recruitment, 25% for technological development and infrastructure, and 15% for operations and team. Priorities include national expansion and B2B services launch.

q4.question: What is the company's valuation?
q4.answer: Valuation is negotiable and depends on investment terms. We base it on current traction metrics, growth potential and comparisons with similar companies in the region. We discuss specific details in meetings with interested investors.

q5.question: What risks do you identify?
q5.answer: Main risks include market competition, dependence on recruiting quality producers, and changes in consumer behavior. We have clear mitigation strategies for each risk and a robust continuity plan.

q6.question: How do we measure investment success?
q6.answer: Key metrics include: number of active producers, order volume, recurring revenue, customer retention rate, and progress towards profitability. We provide regular reports and complete transparency on performance.

q7.question: Are there opportunities for subsequent investments?
q7.answer: Yes, we plan subsequent rounds (Series A) for international expansion and development of new services. Investors from the current round will have priority and preferential terms in future rounds.

q8.question: How can I schedule a meeting?
q8.answer: You can contact us directly through the contact form with type "investor" or by email at investitori@farme.ro. We organize personalized meetings where we present complete details about the opportunity and answer all your questions.
